community-9cbe205a8df2648d.description: Use Angular's TypeScript components to build a timetable with shared navigation and editable class details.

guidance.bestFor: A multi-page web app whose components share form data and navigation.
guidance.caveat: Use the Angular major version already in the project when choosing packages and examples.

community-cd1cf756a3cceed5.name: Ant Design for React Native
community-cd1cf756a3cceed5.description: Build the list, inputs and buttons for a mobile sign-up screen with Ant Design's React Native components.

guidance.bestFor: A native class app where students enter information on a phone.
guidance.caveat: This package targets React Native. Choose the mobile web package for a site that opens in a browser.

community-735362ce9672e68f.description: Install a set of Vue controls for an inventory table, filters and an item-editing form.

guidance.bestFor: Adding consistent forms and tables to a Vue admin interface.
guidance.caveat: Use the Vue package and match its major version to the app; examples for Ant Design React use different APIs.

community-eb59c0a4da328793.description: Use mobile web controls such as a picker and popup to build a touch-friendly check-in form.

guidance.bestFor: A React website that students open on their phones.
guidance.caveat: These controls target a browser. An app built with React Native needs the separate native package.

community-f8f43e49b0d97e16.name: Ant Design Charts
community-f8f43e49b0d97e16.description: Use Ant Design Charts to plot daily attendance as a line chart in React.

guidance.bestFor: A dashboard whose chart maps a date column to the x-axis and a measured value to the y-axis.
guidance.caveat: The chart expects data records and field mappings; turn API responses into that shape before rendering.

community-641875415b61f754.description: Build a content site with Astro and hydrate an interactive widget only on the pages that need it.

guidance.bestFor: A portfolio with mostly static project pages and one interactive filter.
guidance.caveat: A UI component can render as plain HTML. Choose a client directive on the components that need browser interaction.

community-ee40d88ea29e0b09.description: Use Axios to request a public forecast API and show the result or an error in your interface.

guidance.bestFor: An app that shares request configuration across several JSON endpoints.
guidance.caveat: Browser requests still follow the server's CORS policy. A client library cannot grant cross-origin access.

community-6a1de1ab9f404553.description: Run Biome's formatter and linter to spot inconsistent code before merging a pull request.

guidance.bestFor: A team that wants one check for formatting and code quality on changed files.
guidance.caveat: Choose which formatter owns each file type before enabling automatic fixes alongside an existing formatter.

community-cd1cb5b5b252b6c0.name: CPython source
community-cd1cb5b5b252b6c0.description: Read the CPython interpreter source to investigate how a Python operation works under the hood.

guidance.bestFor: Inspecting or contributing to the implementation that runs Python programs.
guidance.caveat: The default branch contains development source. Install a released Python interpreter to run an ordinary Python app.

community-52cd6f5e3bc52f48.description: Write a Cypress browser test that signs in, submits a form and checks the result the user sees.

guidance.bestFor: Rerunning a checkout or login flow whenever the website changes.
guidance.caveat: Run the app with repeatable test data and controlled test accounts so a failing assertion points to the interface.

community-dfc80ee0426fca56.description: Bind data to SVG marks with D3 to create a custom scatterplot, scale or interactive axis.

guidance.bestFor: A data story with chart interactions or marks that a preset chart cannot express.
guidance.caveat: You define the scales, marks and updates. Budget time for labels and accessible alternatives.

community-0dc082de2306e07e.name: Deno
community-0dc082de2306e07e.description: Use the Deno runtime to run a TypeScript script that fetches and transforms a dataset.

guidance.bestFor: Sharing a command-line tool written in TypeScript without a separate compile step.
guidance.caveat: Deno restricts access to the network and filesystem by default. Grant only what the script needs.

community-68c89894eae48486.description: Build a documentation website with Docusaurus from your team's Markdown or MDX pages.

guidance.bestFor: A guide with a sidebar for installation instructions, concepts and examples.
guidance.caveat: The generator produces a site to deploy. Decide which docs version goes with each software release.

community-1ce554b3198255e9.description: Configure ESLint to flag problematic JavaScript patterns in the editor and in a pull request.

guidance.bestFor: Catching repeated mistakes in agent-written code before review.
guidance.caveat: Check which rules and plugins your project enables. A clean lint run still needs behavioral tests.

community-f12f3d8cb55abc01.description: Add Express routes and middleware for an API that reads and creates assignments.

guidance.bestFor: A small Node service where the team wants control over routes and JSON responses.
guidance.caveat: Express leaves validation and persistence to your app. Decide how a route handles a malformed request.

community-3fc86703f4dd4d8f.description: Create a Fastify endpoint with a schema that checks the shape of incoming JSON.

guidance.bestFor: An API that should reject an incorrect score or missing player ID before saving it.
guidance.caveat: Use schemas you control; Fastify's validation and serialization compile schemas into executable functions.

community-2bc0f0f249f8cb71.description: Define a small HTTP API with Hono and run it on a supported server or edge runtime.

guidance.bestFor: A webhook or JSON endpoint that uses standard Request and Response objects.
guidance.caveat: Runtime-specific services such as a database binding still need the adapter or setup for your chosen host.

community-e36cbf2093afe536.description: Write Jest unit tests for a score calculation, including ties and missing values.

guidance.bestFor: Checking deterministic logic or mocking a dependency so a failure can be reproduced locally.
guidance.caveat: A passing unit test with a mock cannot confirm that the real database or browser behaves the same way.

community-81d116c0938bf51a.description: Use Lodash utilities to group records by team or sort a list before displaying it.

guidance.bestFor: Working with nested collections where a small reusable transformation makes the data flow easier to read.
guidance.caveat: Compare the needed function with the JavaScript methods already available before adding the dependency.

community-8e24af85aec962ff.name: NestJS
community-8e24af85aec962ff.description: Use Nest modules, controllers and services to organize a Node API as more routes are added.

guidance.bestFor: An API with several domains that share services, such as assignments and student accounts.
guidance.caveat: Its dependency injection and module structure add setup. Decide which data and operations belong to each module.

community-dcb792d718508bec.description: Use the Next.js App Router to give a portfolio an index and a URL for every project.

guidance.bestFor: A React site with shared layouts and nested pages that should open directly from a link.
guidance.caveat: Keep server and client component boundaries in mind when adding interactions that need browser APIs.

community-e6ca8458e9c714f4.name: NG-ZORRO
community-e6ca8458e9c714f4.description: Use NG-ZORRO's Angular table components to add filters and sorting to a lab inventory.

guidance.bestFor: A data-heavy Angular page that uses Ant Design's visual conventions.
guidance.caveat: Choose client-side or server-side sorting and pagination to match how many records the table receives.

community-202ed8802a6eae23.description: Create a Vue site with Nuxt that renders a public project page for each entry in a catalog.

guidance.bestFor: A Vue app with routing and server rendering as well as interactive controls.
guidance.caveat: Code that touches window or document must run in the browser when the page also renders on the server.

community-1304a105f0946866.description: Start Parcel from an HTML entry file to build and preview a small site with bundled scripts and styles.

guidance.bestFor: A student project that has an HTML file and wants a development server and production build.
guidance.caveat: Serve the generated output from the production build. The development server serves a different workflow.

community-4263a6f361fd9d1e.description: Create a Pinia store so a Vue list and detail view can both update the same favorite items.

guidance.bestFor: Sharing reactive application state across components without passing it through several parents.
guidance.caveat: Use the release that supports your Vue major version. Persisting a store after refresh needs an explicit strategy.

community-b399aaf67c8c753f.description: Use pnpm to install JavaScript dependencies and manage packages in a multi-project workspace.

guidance.bestFor: A team sharing dependencies across several packages with a committed pnpm lockfile.
guidance.caveat: Use the package manager and lockfile the repository declares so teammates and CI resolve the same dependencies.

community-15f5136fd03f9ab3.description: Render a lightweight interactive widget with Preact components and JSX.

guidance.bestFor: An embedded search or voting widget where the amount of client JavaScript matters.
guidance.caveat: Some React libraries depend on React-specific behavior. Check compatibility before using them in a Preact app.

community-b9458b212c01ead3.name: Prisma ORM
community-b9458b212c01ead3.description: Use Prisma ORM to express database reads and writes for a TypeScript assignment tracker.

guidance.bestFor: An app that regularly reads related records, such as courses and their assignments.
guidance.caveat: Check the Prisma major version in your project. The repository distinguishes development and supported release branches.

community-31ff6e314f2a5cf3.description: Give a React app separate routes for a team list and each team's page using React Router.

guidance.bestFor: A client app whose screens must work with external links and browser Back.
guidance.caveat: Match examples to your router mode. Declarative, data and framework setups expose different features.

community-5c4dd456ca1735be.description: Track shared state and named actions so several views can react to the same cart update.

guidance.bestFor: An app where many controls update the same data and the team wants to trace what changed.
guidance.caveat: The Redux team recommends Redux Toolkit for new Redux code. Older examples often contain unnecessary manual setup.

community-9f028105decfa304.name: Remix 3 source
community-9f028105decfa304.description: Explore the Remix 3 source and examples for building web features around browser and server APIs.

guidance.bestFor: Investigating the design and implementation of the developing Remix framework.
guidance.caveat: The linked default branch is Remix 3 under active development. Match tutorials and API examples to the version you actually run.

community-ea794a1f5f672288.name: Node.js
community-ea794a1f5f672288.description: Use the Node.js runtime to run a JavaScript script or server outside the browser.

guidance.bestFor: Automating a build task or serving data to a frontend using JavaScript.
guidance.caveat: The link leads to the runtime's source repository. For a project, install a supported Node release matching its declared version.

community-5dd06ff1ad737e1b.description: Extract repeated styles into Sass variables and mixins and compile the result to CSS.

guidance.bestFor: A site with repeated style rules that would benefit from a shared authoring pattern.
guidance.caveat: Browsers consume the compiled CSS. An SCSS file needs a compiler or a build step before it ships.

community-43d3ef9bd32addf2.description: Build a reactive filter component with Svelte and compile it to browser JavaScript.

guidance.bestFor: A form or list whose displayed content should update when its state changes.
guidance.caveat: Svelte components need a compatible compiler and build setup. Match syntax to the project's Svelte version.

community-b662278c0d08c19d.name: Tailwind CSS
community-b662278c0d08c19d.description: Build responsive cards by applying Tailwind utility classes in the markup.

guidance.bestFor: A page where teammates want consistent spacing, colors and responsive breakpoints.
guidance.caveat: Ensure the build can discover the class names you use, especially when markup is generated.

community-0d8bce7e29a5cd98.name: Visual Studio Code source (Code - OSS)
community-0d8bce7e29a5cd98.description: Inspect the Code - OSS implementation behind Visual Studio Code to see how editor features are built.

guidance.bestFor: Working on the editor itself or investigating how a feature behaves in its open-source implementation.
guidance.caveat: This repository contains Code - OSS source. The packaged Visual Studio Code distribution includes Microsoft-specific customizations.

community-2b14193563ce6363.description: Use Vite's development server and build command to iterate on a browser app.

guidance.bestFor: Starting a frontend with quick local updates and an optimized production build.
guidance.caveat: Check the production build separately from the development server, especially asset paths under your deployment URL.

community-9f8aa196366d6171.name: Vue 2 (legacy)
community-9f8aa196366d6171.description: Read the original Vue 2 source while maintaining or migrating an older Vue application.

guidance.bestFor: Tracing behavior in an existing application pinned to Vue 2.
guidance.caveat: Vue 2 has reached end of life. Use the current Vue guide and supported Vue release for a new project.

community-26bdc348dc94e4e5.description: Use webpack to bundle application modules and process styles or other assets through loaders.

guidance.bestFor: An existing frontend that already has a webpack config and needs another entry or asset type.
guidance.caveat: Loaders and plugins affect different stages. Changing both at once makes a build failure harder to isolate.

community-60c94267a77d6d05.name: Yarn Classic (v1)
community-60c94267a77d6d05.description: Use the Yarn Classic source and documentation to maintain dependencies in a project pinned to Yarn 1.

guidance.bestFor: Reproducing an existing Yarn 1 installation or debugging a legacy yarn.lock workflow.
guidance.caveat: This repository covers Yarn 1. Modern Yarn has different releases, settings and installation instructions.

community-d8864b187c866fa6.description: Use Cursor to ask an agent to inspect project files, propose an edit and work through its implementation.

guidance.bestFor: Tracing a behavior across several files in an existing codebase before making a change.
guidance.caveat: Review the actual diff and run the project's own checks before accepting the change.

community-3b1a46da764e4da9.description: Use Bun to run a TypeScript script, install dependencies or execute a project's tests.

guidance.bestFor: Prototyping a small JavaScript service with the runtime and toolchain together.
guidance.caveat: Check dependencies and deployment support before switching an existing Node project to Bun.

community-511343c5e0711328.name: draw.io (diagrams.net)
community-511343c5e0711328.description: Draw the steps of a password reset or data flow in a browser and share the diagram with your agent.

guidance.bestFor: Agreeing on branches, error states and handoffs before implementing a feature.
guidance.caveat: Keep the editable diagram along with the exported image so teammates can change the flow.

community-b6ebf74696c4482c.description: Build a small 2D game in Godot by arranging scenes, scripting movement and responding to collisions.

guidance.bestFor: A playable prototype with a character, obstacles and a score display.
guidance.caveat: Choose tutorials for the installed Godot version, then test collision shapes and input in the running game.

community-2d59a23a2b457c95.description: Open a project in OpenCode to ask questions about its files and work through a change from the terminal.

guidance.bestFor: Inspecting an unfamiliar codebase alongside an agent that can use project tools.
guidance.caveat: Configure the model provider you intend to use and check tool permissions before letting it run project commands.

community-6529347d85fd03e3.description: Design a responsive site in Framer and connect repeated content such as portfolio entries through its CMS.

guidance.bestFor: Publishing a site your teammates can continue editing visually.
guidance.caveat: Decide whether Framer will host and manage the site before building around its CMS and publishing tools.

community-1e23cc4ffa5176b0.name: Chart.js
community-1e23cc4ffa5176b0.description: Render a bar or line chart from labeled data in a canvas element using Chart.js.

guidance.bestFor: A dashboard with common chart types such as scores by game or attendance by day.
guidance.caveat: Provide an accessible text summary or data table as well as the canvas drawing.

community-60a5de8a1a5913c3.description: Choose a Frontend Mentor challenge and implement a responsive page against a supplied design brief.

guidance.bestFor: Practicing how to translate a visual specification into a working, testable interface.
guidance.caveat: Check the assets included with the specific challenge before planning your implementation.

community-5fa3274eddcae7de.name: Figma Design
community-5fa3274eddcae7de.description: Create a shared Figma design to show layout, components and screen states before your agent writes the interface.

guidance.bestFor: Getting feedback on a form's empty, error and complete states before coding them.
guidance.caveat: A clickable prototype can illustrate interactions, but still needs working validation, data and navigation in the app.

community-a69034dde468b5bd.description: Build an interactive animation in Rive and load the exported file with the runtime for your app.

guidance.bestFor: Animating a mascot or control that changes state in response to a user's input.
guidance.caveat: Choose a runtime that supports the features used in the file and wire the animation inputs to real app events.

community-9652cfee3a6e3a26.name: GIMP
community-9652cfee3a6e3a26.description: Edit a photo in layers and export a transparent PNG for a player card or website banner.

guidance.bestFor: Cut a subject out of a team photo and place it on a new background.
guidance.caveat: Save an XCF copy before exporting. The PNG combines the visible layers into a single image.

community-1557d6500f286e52.description: Open the palette generator to build a color scheme and copy swatch values into your site's CSS.

guidance.bestFor: Keep a team's existing brand color and explore matching accent colors for its scoreboard.
guidance.caveat: A matching palette can still have unreadable text. Test the exact foreground and background combination you plan to use.

community-03a89053f2f115c3.description: Browse models and datasets, then open a model card to see what a project can run or adapt.

guidance.bestFor: Find an image classifier and check which labels and examples it supports before designing the interface.
guidance.caveat: Models have individual licenses, limitations and input formats. Check the card for the model you select.

community-ae550e9c2d6c7bad.description: Install the Flutter SDK to build a mobile, web or desktop app from Dart widgets.

guidance.bestFor: Build a study timer with the same screens and controls on Android and iOS.
guidance.caveat: Set up the tools for each target platform. A successful web preview does not test the native builds.

community-6897bacf002e7976.description: Browse four-color palettes and copy colors for a poster, landing page or dashboard.

guidance.bestFor: Choose a consistent set of colors for teams, buttons and page backgrounds.
guidance.caveat: These are community submissions. Check legibility before assigning two swatches to text and its background.

community-6e7f58f6b868b28a.name: Go
community-6e7f58f6b868b28a.description: Read Go's tutorials and use its toolchain to write a small HTTP service with routes and JSON responses.

guidance.bestFor: Build an API that lists music albums and accepts a new album from a form.
guidance.caveat: The Gin tutorial keeps data in memory. Add persistent storage before expecting records to survive a restart.

community-785f2a176f788519.description: Use Expo's React Native tools to build a phone app and preview screens on a device.

guidance.bestFor: Make a club check-in app whose buttons and navigation use native mobile components.
guidance.caveat: Expo Go ships with a fixed set of native modules. Adding custom native code calls for a development build.

community-acbd23c8bfe89df0.description: Draw a scalable logo with vector paths, edit the shapes and export a web asset.

guidance.bestFor: Create a crisp team crest for both a navigation icon and a large header.
guidance.caveat: Keep the original SVG for later resizing. Exporting only a small PNG fixes the available resolution.

community-ccb0d01a683cb2ce.description: Send an HTTP request with chosen headers and parameters, then inspect its status and response in Postman.

guidance.bestFor: Reproduce an API error before connecting the endpoint to a student-facing form.
guidance.caveat: A successful request here does not establish that a browser page may call the endpoint across origins. Test the frontend too.

community-63f00916b80a4e87.description: Open an interactive coding lesson and practice a language feature in small exercises.

guidance.bestFor: Learn just enough JavaScript conditionals to explain why an agent's filter skips a row.
guidance.caveat: Choose a course matching your current language. Transfer the exercise to your repository to check your understanding.

community-eae789634e3477cd.description: Find a motion asset and use a compatible Lottie player to add a looping loader or a success animation.

guidance.bestFor: Preview an animated checkmark before embedding it in a form's confirmation screen.
guidance.caveat: Match the exported file format to the player and give users who reduce motion a static confirmation.

community-6355c1abf82e4fcf.description: Follow the Python examples to define HTTP endpoints and try requests in the generated interactive API documentation.

guidance.bestFor: Give a homework tracker a JSON endpoint that looks up an assignment by ID.
guidance.caveat: The Python server runs separately from the browser interface. Point the frontend at the running API.

community-4b1af71a907b6013.description: Load a machine-learning model in the browser for a creative JavaScript sketch.

guidance.bestFor: Make an on-screen drawing respond to detected hand points from a webcam.
guidance.caveat: Webcam examples depend on camera access and a model download. Include a waiting state before predictions begin.

community-42004a7f8f43f7e7.name: CSS-Tricks
community-42004a7f8f43f7e7.description: Read illustrated CSS explanations alongside examples of layout rules for containers and their children.

guidance.bestFor: Diagnose why a row of navigation buttons wraps or leaves uneven space.
guidance.caveat: First identify the flex container. A rule placed on the child can affect a different part of the layout.

community-4ccc1494ef6cd65d.description: Pack selected repository files into one text document that a coding agent can read.

guidance.bestFor: Give an agent just the routes, UI and tests involved in a bug in one upload.
guidance.caveat: Set inclusion and ignore rules and inspect the output before sharing. Large dependency trees consume context needlessly.

community-fd9f02188375c5f6.description: Read Zig syntax and compiler examples for topics such as error handling, slices and memory management.

guidance.bestFor: Look up the type of a slice when reviewing a Zig parser written by an agent.
guidance.caveat: The linked master reference tracks development. Select the manual matching your installed compiler.

community-9ce0111413787035.description: Follow Flask's quickstart to map a URL to a Python function and return HTML or a response.

guidance.bestFor: Serve a small classroom poll on a local route before adding a database.
guidance.caveat: Use the built-in development server for local work. Choose a production WSGI server for a deployment.

community-9a8584b373e27e5d.description: Sketch a user flow on the online whiteboard, or use the separate React SDK to embed a drawing canvas.

guidance.bestFor: Draw the path from login to a completed task and hand the diagram to your coding agent.
guidance.caveat: Using the hosted whiteboard needs no React project. Embedding the editor requires the SDK, its stylesheet and a sized container.

community-aef7c9db81c68ce2.description: Use Python figures and axes to plot data and label the result for a notebook or report.

guidance.bestFor: Compare daily sensor readings with a line chart that names the axes and units.
guidance.caveat: Keep a handle to each Axes when building multiple plots so labels and settings reach the intended chart.

community-8505cde88d7d53ef.description: Open an image in the browser, compare encoders or quality settings, then download the smaller asset.

guidance.bestFor: Shrink a photographic header while checking whether fine details survive.
guidance.caveat: Zoom in on text and sharp edges before exporting. The smallest file can visibly change those details.

community-5caf462d9abb17f6.description: Follow the board setup guides and built-in sketches to upload code to an Arduino.

guidance.bestFor: Run Blink to confirm the computer, board and upload path work before wiring a sensor.
guidance.caveat: Choose the correct board and port in the IDE. The onboard LED setup varies across boards.

community-e9556bbef96608db.description: Choose an icon set and add consistent symbols to navigation, buttons and status labels.

guidance.bestFor: Replace a toolbar's text-only save control with a recognizable icon and an accessible name.
guidance.caveat: Use an icon and style from the package or kit you have configured. Availability varies by collection.

community-73d75733406d9548.name: unDraw
community-73d75733406d9548.description: Browse reusable illustrations and download an SVG for an empty state or onboarding screen.

guidance.bestFor: Add an illustration to the first screen of a reading list before a student saves any books.
guidance.caveat: The license permits using illustrations in projects but restricts redistributing them as an asset collection.

community-a4fe8a0c29be69ae.name: PostgreSQL Documentation
community-a4fe8a0c29be69ae.description: Read versioned SQL examples for storing records, joining tables and querying a relational database.

guidance.bestFor: Join students and club memberships to list the people enrolled in each activity.
guidance.caveat: Use the documentation for the PostgreSQL version on your server. Joining tables requires the right matching keys.

community-4917fe035ec15a0b.description: Use multidimensional Python arrays for calculations on an entire dataset at once.

guidance.bestFor: Normalize columns of sensor readings by subtracting their respective means.
guidance.caveat: Check array shapes before relying on broadcasting. Compatible dimensions can align along a different axis than you intended.

community-03d80ef10378827d.description: Work through runnable tutorials on tensors, data loaders, training loops and prediction.

guidance.bestFor: Train a small image classifier and compare predictions against labeled test examples.
guidance.caveat: Match tensor shapes and the selected device across model and inputs. A tutorial that selects an accelerator needs a CPU fallback.

community-88b199e56e2c7351.description: Explore community-mapped places and streets as the starting point for a location-based project.

guidance.bestFor: Check whether the paths and buildings needed by a campus map are already mapped.
guidance.caveat: Credit OpenStreetMap contributors and check the tile server's policy before embedding a map or prefetching tiles.

community-21359fe8c171c407.description: Design a responsive website visually and use its CMS for repeated content such as club profiles.

guidance.bestFor: Prototype a publication where each interview uses the same page design.
guidance.caveat: Check export coverage if your agent will maintain the result elsewhere. Exported front-end files do not include all hosted CMS behavior.

community-e65dace2be7f1494.description: Explore Kotlin course materials and exercises designed for teaching programming.

guidance.bestFor: Adapt a lesson on functions or conditions into practice questions for a study group.
guidance.caveat: Some materials are written for instructors. Select the exercise and confirm what learners must set up before assigning it.

community-30f11e9a931e1659.description: Run a supported model locally and connect a small app to Ollama's model API.

guidance.bestFor: Build a text summarizer that sends notes to a model running on your laptop.
guidance.caveat: Choose a local model that fits your machine and download it before the demo. Cloud models follow a different setup.

community-ebae70be7c8afbd2.description: Build an internal dashboard by wiring table and form widgets to a database or API query.

guidance.bestFor: Give a club an interface for viewing equipment and updating inventory counts.
guidance.caveat: A widget does not store changes by itself. Wire its submit event to a query with the right data-source permissions.

community-2210207ad3281e35.name: Uiverse
community-2210207ad3281e35.description: Browse community interface snippets and copy the code for a button, loader or other control.

guidance.bestFor: Try several button press effects inside a settings screen before choosing one.
guidance.caveat: Check the snippet's styling format and give icon-only controls a keyboard focus state and an accessible name.

community-46f6ef523788247e.description: Build a browser-based 3D scene using HTML entities for objects, lights and cameras.

guidance.bestFor: Create a virtual gallery that visitors can explore on a normal screen before trying a headset.
guidance.caveat: Test headset interactions on a compatible device. Mouse navigation alone cannot verify VR controls.

community-c18a3784986b167e.description: Configure build tasks and dependencies for a JVM or Android project.

guidance.bestFor: Have every teammate run the same test or package task using the project's Gradle Wrapper.
guidance.caveat: Use the checked-in wrapper to match the project's Gradle version instead of assuming a locally installed version is compatible.

community-d6809f9f369ac027.name: Airtable Web API
community-d6809f9f369ac027.description: Read the API documentation to retrieve or update records in an Airtable base from an app.

guidance.bestFor: Connect an equipment request form to an Airtable inventory that staff can edit.
guidance.caveat: For a personal integration, scope the access token to the needed base and operations. Keep it out of client-side code.

community-3db046d68ce99224.description: Store related records as vertices and edges and query the connections with AQL.

guidance.bestFor: Find the classmates linked through two shared clubs in a student-organization graph.
guidance.caveat: Edge direction and traversal depth change the result. Model which relationships may be followed before writing the query.

community-24a3ef2862c175b1.name: vanilla-extract
community-24a3ef2862c175b1.description: Generate static CSS from typed theme tokens and locally scoped styles written in TypeScript.

guidance.bestFor: Share a typed color and spacing contract across a project's light and dark themes.
guidance.caveat: Configure the integration for your bundler. A plain browser cannot execute the style files as CSS.

community-7ea75a22f67bc51d.description: Use a hosted identity service and its SDK to add sign-in and user profiles to an app.

guidance.bestFor: Let students sign in and return to a private dashboard after authentication.
guidance.caveat: Register the correct callback URL for each environment. A successful login alone does not authorize access to another user's records.

community-bf8208ef46b6a456.name: ApexCharts.js
community-bf8208ef46b6a456.description: Render interactive charts in a web page by passing data series and display options to a JavaScript library.

guidance.bestFor: Plot weekly attendance for several clubs and let the reader compare trends.
guidance.caveat: Review the applicable license for your organization and distribution model before embedding the library in a product.

community-4e62781705efa487.description: Define scheduled workflows in Python and inspect individual task runs in Airflow's interface.

guidance.bestFor: Fetch a daily CSV, validate it and refresh a report only after the previous steps finish.
guidance.caveat: Plan for retries when writing output. Rerunning a failed task should not duplicate rows from a previous attempt.

community-37e54acb88e28331.description: Inspect traces and evaluations to understand how an AI application uses models and tools.

guidance.bestFor: Trace a retrieval agent to see whether a wrong answer began with the search results or the final model response.
guidance.caveat: Set up instrumentation before expecting a trace. Review which prompts, model responses and user data your app sends.

community-971c9f6a114c361b.name: 3dicons
community-971c9f6a114c361b.description: Browse rendered 3D icons for feature cards, empty states and landing pages.

guidance.bestFor: Pick a set of objects with a consistent camera angle and lighting for an onboarding sequence.
guidance.caveat: Check the terms attached to the pack you download. The site lists both free and premium assets.

community-b3d002e12aa77afd.description: Define build and test targets with explicit dependencies for a multi-package codebase.

guidance.bestFor: Build only the targets that depend on a shared C++ library after it changes.
guidance.caveat: Each dependency must be declared for reproducible builds. Budget time to write build rules when adopting Bazel.

community-d8b8a5c5df3c6956.description: Automate repeatable front-end build steps by configuring named tasks in a Gruntfile.

guidance.bestFor: Turn linting and asset processing in an existing JavaScript project into one command.
guidance.caveat: The CLI and the project's local Grunt installation serve different roles. Install the plugins your Gruntfile actually references.

community-05d02281fc374385.description: Open a messy table, explore its values and standardize inconsistent entries before exporting.

guidance.bestFor: Merge spelling variants of school names that would otherwise split a chart into duplicate categories.
guidance.caveat: Inspect proposed clusters before merging. Similar-looking names can represent different schools.

community-48ce218ceec909c6.name: Aurelia
community-48ce218ceec909c6.description: Build a web interface with templates, custom components and data binding through the Aurelia framework.

guidance.bestFor: Implement a filterable roster and bind form inputs to the state displayed by the list.
guidance.caveat: Check the Aurelia major version before copying examples. Use a starter and documentation for the same release.

community-ceb6346b4150b579.description: Read the protocol guides and build a server that exposes selected tools or resources to a compatible AI client.

guidance.bestFor: Give a coding agent a lookup tool for an approved collection of project notes.
guidance.caveat: Connecting the server and authorizing a tool are separate decisions. Expose only the operations your project actually needs.

community-bcb7bf32fafb3f1a.description: Work through staged programming challenges that reconstruct parts of systems such as Redis from scratch.

guidance.bestFor: Implement a Redis-compatible command and use the stage tests to understand the wire protocol.
guidance.caveat: Check access before relying on the testing workflow. Reading stage instructions and submitting a solution have different membership rules.

community-5d7b0d6bd85de5c9.name: Apache ECharts
community-5d7b0d6bd85de5c9.description: Define axes and series in JavaScript to create interactive visualizations for the browser.

guidance.bestFor: Draw a line chart of daily team scores and pair the category labels with the correct values.
guidance.caveat: Keep category order and series values aligned. Missing days or independently sorted arrays can mislabel points.

community-b759fdbf70ead576.description: Index documents in a search cluster and query their fields through a search API.

guidance.bestFor: Build a searchable archive of club announcements with text and date filters.
guidance.caveat: Running the engine adds a service to maintain. Use the quickstart locally and review its security settings before opening the server to others.

community-ca8a7a3a9897716a.description: Read Baeldung’s Spring Boot testing tutorial to add a test for a Java web controller.

guidance.bestFor: Choose between a focused controller test and a test that starts the application context.
guidance.caveat: Check the tutorial’s dependency versions against your project before copying annotations or imports.

community-61e99db656a77652.description: Build an Activepieces flow that turns a submitted feedback form into a message for your project team.

guidance.bestFor: Connect a trigger to actions in the services your team already uses, then test the flow with a sample submission.
guidance.caveat: Each connected account needs permission to perform its step. Test with sample records before enabling the trigger.

community-2e2f7f833366781a.description: Add a Chatwoot chat widget to a project and answer visitors’ questions from a shared inbox.

guidance.bestFor: Route an incoming question to a teammate and keep the conversation history visible to the support team.
guidance.caveat: Decide who will monitor the inbox and what students should disclose in chat before placing the widget on a public site.

community-3c4f23dab56aca93.description: Use Unsloth to run a local language model and experiment with fine-tuning it on example responses.

guidance.bestFor: Compare an existing model with an adapter trained to answer a small, specific set of questions.
guidance.caveat: Check the hardware requirements for your chosen model and training method. A model that runs for inference may need more memory for training.

community-8b97b9a45ae80f2b.description: Call OpenRouter’s model API to compare how different language models answer the same project prompt.

guidance.bestFor: Keep the request structure consistent and record the model ID, response and cost for each run.
guidance.caveat: API requests need a key. Keep it on your server and check the selected model’s price before running a batch.

community-1bbd41a7b06070f3.description: Open a Bitwarden vault to organize project logins that teammates need to access.

guidance.bestFor: Share a test account with the appropriate group and update its password in one place.
guidance.caveat: Choose who can access a shared item. Avoid handing a production credential to an agent by pasting the vault entry into its chat.

community-6b817f8f9533480a.description: Install ActivityWatch to see how much of a coding session you spent in the editor and browser.

guidance.bestFor: Compare time spent in broad activity categories across several sessions using locally collected events.
guidance.caveat: An active window shows where the device was focused. It cannot tell whether you were reading code, thinking or away from the keyboard.

community-e9f38658c0e123e1.description: Open a CryptPad instance and write a design brief together in an encrypted shared document.

guidance.bestFor: Collaborate on notes while deciding separately who gets a view link and who can edit.
guidance.caveat: Treat a document’s sharing link as a credential and check its access setting before posting it in a public issue.

community-7f4a442ee05e87e8.description: Use Bytebase to review a database schema change before the migration runs against a shared database.

guidance.bestFor: Give a teammate a chance to review the SQL that adds a column or changes a table.
guidance.caveat: Connect a development database first. Approval of a migration does not prove that existing application queries will still work.

community-3a4feba660e650f8.description: Install Payload in a Next.js project to give editors an admin screen for publishing student articles.

guidance.bestFor: Define collections for authors and posts once, then use them in the admin interface and the site.
guidance.caveat: Plan the database and access rules for drafts before giving editors accounts or exposing the content API.

community-b34b1955b3ac37c0.description: Set up a Bugzilla tracker for a project where testers file bugs and developers record fixes.

guidance.bestFor: Collect steps to reproduce a bug, assign it and follow it through verification.
guidance.caveat: Set up products, components and permissions first so reports arrive in a queue somebody actually monitors.

community-a836bfd4d0fa0e7a.description: Connect an app to Appwrite for account sign-in, uploaded files and persistent records.

guidance.bestFor: Build a homework submission page where a signed-in student can retrieve their own uploads.
guidance.caveat: Configure permissions on each collection or bucket. Signing a user in does not by itself restrict which records they can read.

community-b6b92f50b571271b.description: Browse edX courses to find a structured lesson for a skill your project needs, such as Python or data analysis.

guidance.bestFor: Compare the syllabus, prerequisites and exercise format before picking a course for independent study.
guidance.caveat: Enrollment, assessment access and certificates depend on the individual offering. Check the course page before planning around a graded assignment.

community-872a3430334da3e3.description: Build a custom tracker in Twenty CRM for a team’s contacts, meetings and follow-up tasks.

guidance.bestFor: Link people to organizations and record when a teammate should follow up.
guidance.caveat: Choose record types and relationships before importing a contact spreadsheet. Resolve duplicates before assigning follow-ups.

community-e1d1c75f4c676942.description: Read a roadmap.sh learning path to break a broad goal such as learning backend development into topics.

guidance.bestFor: Find the next missing skill in your project and open that topic’s learning resources.
guidance.caveat: A roadmap covers an entire role. Select the branches your project needs now and use a small exercise to check understanding.

community-33291c4d5f218ed4.description: Open ChartDB to turn your database’s schema metadata into a diagram of tables and relationships.

guidance.bestFor: Show how assignments, students and submissions connect without drawing every column manually.
guidance.caveat: Use the import query for your database engine. Review the schema metadata before sharing a diagram outside your team.

community-0f1093f2dd068481.description: Install Astropy and read a FITS image’s header and data array from Python.

guidance.bestFor: Inspect observation metadata before plotting the corresponding astronomical image.
guidance.caveat: A FITS file can contain multiple header/data units. Select the extension holding the image you actually want.

community-b1274842c3912a06.description: Use Ente Photos to collect and share an encrypted album of images from a class project.

guidance.bestFor: Give contributors an album link and organize their photos into one collection.
guidance.caveat: Decide whether the link should allow contributions or just viewing before sending it to the class.

community-e41e212f7d704d8c.description: Use an AppFlowy workspace to put a project board, meeting notes and team documents in one place.

guidance.bestFor: Turn decisions from a planning session into tracked tasks beside the notes that explain them.
guidance.caveat: Self-hosting makes the team responsible for server updates and backups. Establish who maintains the workspace before depending on it.

community-276e328b01f109da.description: Set up a Rocket.Chat workspace with channels for announcements, support and project discussions.

guidance.bestFor: Separate general questions from team conversations and retain their history in a shared space.
guidance.caveat: Assign channel membership and moderation roles before inviting everyone. A public channel may expose the full conversation history.

community-2757fbbf336ac035.description: Apply Charts.css to an HTML table to display a bar chart of weekly project totals.

guidance.bestFor: Keep the data in table cells while styling the same values as a chart in the browser.
guidance.caveat: Supply the chart’s sizing values and readable labels when the source data changes. CSS styling alone cannot calculate totals for you.

community-c7a821d203a3becf.description: Connect a benchmark suite to Bencher to track whether changes make a hot function slower.

guidance.bestFor: Compare runs of the same benchmark over commits and inspect possible performance regressions.
guidance.caveat: Runner hardware and background load can swamp small differences. Establish a baseline before failing a build over a timing change.

community-168cdb70759c589f.description: Deploy Flarum to host a discussion forum where students can tag questions and revisit earlier answers.

guidance.bestFor: Give project questions a persistent home with searchable discussions and a moderation queue.
guidance.caveat: Decide which users can start, tag or moderate discussions. Check extension compatibility when upgrading the forum.

community-13da1f870f5ca6ff.description: Use Swagger’s OpenAPI tools to describe endpoints and present interactive documentation for your API.

guidance.bestFor: Let another student inspect the request fields and try a sample request against a test server.
guidance.caveat: The displayed examples come from the API specification. Update it when the implementation changes so the docs describe the deployed endpoints.

community-dbed699620a2193a.description: Install Syncthing on two devices to synchronize a project folder directly between them.

guidance.bestFor: Keep working files available on both machines while controlling which folders and devices participate.
guidance.caveat: Deleting a file can propagate to the other device. Keep independent backups for files you need to recover.

community-2327a176271d39da.description: Use Cohere’s Rerank API to reorder a shortlist of documents for a student’s search query.

guidance.bestFor: Compare the original search order with the model’s order on questions where you already know the best document.
guidance.caveat: Retrieve the candidate documents first. The reranker can reorder what you send, so a missing source cannot appear in its answer.

community-13b81f91358639cf.description: Read Continue’s acquisition announcement and follow the project repository to study its open-source coding agent.

guidance.bestFor: Investigate an existing Continue integration or learn how an editor and a coding agent exchange context.
guidance.caveat: Continue announced it joined Cursor. Check maintenance and release status in the repository before choosing it for a new dependency.

community-c5f33e7c0fc832c8.description: Open a repository in GitKraken Desktop to inspect branches and commits before merging a teammate’s change.

guidance.bestFor: Trace where two branches diverged and review the files changed in a particular commit.
guidance.caveat: Check which local branch and remote are selected before using a push or merge action in the visual client.

community-9c4f3bd0258f241f.description: Add Swiper to a site to create a swipeable gallery of photos or project demos.

guidance.bestFor: Give a portfolio a touch-friendly carousel with arrows, pagination and individually selectable slides.
guidance.caveat: Add a keyboard-accessible way to change slides and test how much of the next slide is visible on a narrow phone.

community-e522237149c58c29.description: Use Svix to deliver signed webhook events when an action happens in your app.

guidance.bestFor: Notify another service when a submission arrives and inspect delivery attempts if the receiver is offline.
guidance.caveat: Retries can deliver an event more than once. Verify its signature and have the receiver recognize event IDs it has already processed.

community-dac34d4486c6232e.description: Launch a Discourse forum where a class can ask questions, discuss releases and find earlier answers.

guidance.bestFor: Organize help threads by topic so that a solution remains useful to the next person with the same question.
guidance.caveat: Choose categories and who can read or moderate them. Private project discussions need deliberate access settings.

community-ae3746e139f8ac29.description: Add DataTables to an HTML table to sort, search and paginate a list of assignments.

guidance.bestFor: Let a student find an assignment by title or order rows by a column without reloading the full page.
guidance.caveat: Client-side filtering sees only rows supplied to the browser. Choose server-side processing if the full dataset is too large to send.

community-edee6fbff82f9c91.description: Deploy Harbor to store container images for a team and manage which members can pull or publish them.

guidance.bestFor: Keep a private registry for a shared deployment and inspect image vulnerability scans before rollout.
guidance.caveat: Plan persistent storage, certificates and permissions. A shared registry becomes an availability dependency for future deployments.

community-b54b9095c5ce4108.description: Write a Robot Framework acceptance test that describes a user journey as a sequence of keywords.

guidance.bestFor: Turn a repeated task such as signing in and checking a status into a test a teammate can read.
guidance.caveat: Install and configure the library that implements your keywords. Browser automation needs an appropriate browser library and runtime.

community-2dfb2b98942aa350.description: Index project titles and tags in Typesense to add typo-tolerant search and filters to a catalog.

guidance.bestFor: Help a visitor find an item even when its name is slightly misspelled, then narrow the matches by a facet.
guidance.caveat: Plan how updates in your database reach the search index. Put a search-only key in the browser and keep administrative access on the server.

community-cc11e4c69adb7140.description: Use drawDB in a browser to model tables, connect foreign keys and export the SQL for your chosen database.

guidance.bestFor: Sketch students, courses and enrollments before writing the first migration.
guidance.caveat: Choose the correct database dialect before exporting and review the generated statements before running them against existing data.

community-5c59cd357f820dc4.name: draw.io product guide
community-5c59cd357f820dc4.description: Open the draw.io product site for guides to diagramming and a link into its browser editor.

guidance.bestFor: Choose a storage option and diagram type before sketching a login flow or service architecture.
guidance.caveat: This is the product site for the same editor listed as draw.io. Save the editable drawing as well as any image you export.

community-1a894bd0f99797f9.description: Install GTK and a language binding to build a native desktop window with controls and click handlers.

guidance.bestFor: Create a small desktop utility with a file picker, a button and a status message.
guidance.caveat: Match your toolkit version and examples. GTK 3 and GTK 4 differ in their widgets and application APIs.

community-fa01c19d3e5dc77c.description: Run Keycloak to let two project apps sign users in through the same identity provider.

guidance.bestFor: Give the apps separate clients and reuse the same account across both.
guidance.caveat: Register the correct redirect URI for each client and configure the app to enforce its roles after login.

community-aaf2008b2dd1733d.description: Add UnoCSS to a frontend build to generate styles from utility classes used in your markup.

guidance.bestFor: Keep a small set of spacing and color rules consistent across buttons, cards and navigation.
guidance.caveat: The extractor needs complete class names. Use literal alternatives or a safelist for classes constructed from runtime values.

community-16859c5182eb47d6.description: Open an Etherpad instance to draft a team specification together and inspect its revision history.

guidance.bestFor: Have teammates annotate acceptance criteria in a shared text document and see who edited each section.
guidance.caveat: Check the instance’s sharing settings before posting a pad URL. Choose where to host and retain pads containing private notes.

community-dd2bae099b20c93e.description: Use Documenso to send a sample project agreement through a document-signing workflow.

guidance.bestFor: Place fields for two participants and test what each recipient sees before the document is completed.
guidance.caveat: Confirm recipient addresses and field assignments with a test document before sending a real agreement.

community-5b1869603a207c33.description: Choose matching Iconoir symbols for a toolbar and use their SVG files or framework components.

guidance.bestFor: Use one icon family for search, bookmarks and navigation across a web or mobile interface.
guidance.caveat: Give icon-only buttons a text label for assistive technology. A consistent drawing style cannot explain an ambiguous action.

community-40e0c2050ea632a7.description: Install a Fontsource font package and serve the font files with your site.

guidance.bestFor: Keep the same typeface in your app without depending on a third-party font request at page load.
guidance.caveat: Import only the weights, styles and character subsets that your pages use. Check that students’ names render in the selected subset.

community-cc76cd5cb3935b13.description: Call Exa from your backend to find web pages and retrieve text for a research assistant.

guidance.bestFor: Present links alongside generated summaries so students can inspect the pages that supported an answer.
guidance.caveat: Keep the API key on the server. Inspect the returned pages before treating a retrieved passage as evidence.

community-6df9102a5a645844.description: Install Framework7 to create a mobile-style interface with pages, navigation and touch controls.

guidance.bestFor: Prototype a tabbed schedule app in the browser and check how it feels on a phone.
guidance.caveat: A browser prototype cannot exercise every native feature. Plan separate packaging and device testing if the project needs an app-store build.

community-110e7243c6a2d147.description: Save links, PDFs and screenshots in Karakeep and search the collection when you need an old reference.

guidance.bestFor: Build a personal design notebook where a remembered phrase can lead back to the original page.
guidance.caveat: Some sites block page capture or require a login. Check the saved item before relying on it as an offline copy.

community-ba98721e17380a8d.description: Host Forgejo for a team that wants to manage Git repositories, issues and code reviews on its own server.

guidance.bestFor: Keep project planning and pull requests beside the source code under the team’s control.
guidance.caveat: Assign someone to maintain updates, backups and repository access before moving the team’s only checkout to the server.

community-53755613855171df.description: Use Firezone to give selected teammates access to a private development service.

guidance.bestFor: Connect a teammate to an internal dashboard while limiting access to the resources their account needs.
guidance.caveat: Install a gateway that can actually reach the private service and test the access rules with a non-admin account.

community-34108d2e35c75d1c.description: Host FreshRSS to gather updates from engineering blogs, podcasts and release feeds in one reader.

guidance.bestFor: Give a project team a reading queue that lists new posts from its chosen sources.
guidance.caveat: A site needs a feed or another supported source. Check that your server’s refresh schedule picks up new posts.

community-02c136fed3ac4e98.description: Define a Kestra workflow that fetches a dataset, transforms it and produces a report on a schedule.

guidance.bestFor: Keep task order, retries and execution history visible when a multi-step job fails.
guidance.caveat: Design retryable tasks so a second run cannot publish the same report twice. Check which plugins and credentials each task needs.

community-7f6d808bb0169574.description: Add Vueform fields to a Vue page to collect and validate assignment submissions.

guidance.bestFor: Build a multi-field form with a date picker, file input and validation feedback.
guidance.caveat: Match the guide to the Vueform version you install. A file picker still needs a configured upload destination on your server.

community-c9038abab275528d.description: Open the regex playground and run a pattern against a few valid and invalid student IDs.

guidance.bestFor: See exactly which characters matched, then save example strings as pass/fail tests before using the pattern in a form.
guidance.caveat: Select the same regex flavor as your application. JavaScript and PCRE can interpret the same expression differently.

community-b1f3826153725497.description: Install Medusa to give a school merchandise store a product catalog, carts and order management.

guidance.bestFor: Model a shirt with several sizes, add the variants to a cart and inspect the resulting order in the admin.
guidance.caveat: The backend and storefront run separately. The local starter also needs PostgreSQL, so budget time for the database.

community-f88d8672a247a8ce.description: Use Flagsmith to release a redesigned dashboard to a small group before turning it on for everyone.

guidance.bestFor: Keep two implementations in one release and choose between them with an environment or user-segment flag.
guidance.caveat: Your app needs to define what happens when a flag is off or its value is unavailable. Test that path before rollout.

community-9bac3f4057df8fed.description: Run the Gogs Git service on your own server to host repositories for a class team.

guidance.bestFor: Give a small group a private central Git remote on a machine it controls.
guidance.caveat: Someone must maintain the server and back up its repositories and database. A local Git checkout alone does not provide team hosting.

community-be05c4a4ab614ba0.description: Instrument an AI app with Langfuse to inspect the model calls, retrieval and tools behind a single answer.

guidance.bestFor: Follow a poor chatbot response back to the search or model step that produced it.
guidance.caveat: Only instrumented operations appear in a trace. Decide which inputs and outputs you need to record before sending them.

community-8093ce1859740e0e.name: TanStack Query for Svelte
community-8093ce1859740e0e.description: Follow the Svelte Query guide to fetch an assignment list, cache the response and refresh it after submitting work.

guidance.bestFor: Keep server data in sync across Svelte views without writing separate loading and refresh logic for each one.
guidance.caveat: Use the Svelte adapter's reactive function syntax. Pasting the React examples changes how updates are tracked.

community-9f8dcaa7e55487eb.description: Run Caddy in front of a web app to route requests and serve the site over HTTPS.

guidance.bestFor: Publish a project through a domain while the application listens on a different local port.
guidance.caveat: For public certificate issuance, point the domain's DNS at the server and check the documented network requirements.

community-b4c308e9449a9c53.description: Use Formbricks to create a short feedback survey that classmates can open from a link.

guidance.bestFor: Gather reactions to a prototype, then use an embedded survey if you need feedback at a particular point in the app.
guidance.caveat: A shareable survey link works outside your application. Triggering an in-app survey requires connecting it to the app.

community-662faebc5d3a2d6a.description: Install Hugo and turn a folder of Markdown articles into a browsable project journal.

guidance.bestFor: Publish a collection of weekly notes with shared templates and a static deployment.
guidance.caveat: Draft pages can appear in the development preview but be excluded from the published site. Check their draft setting before building.

community-e69d64e782a70f83.description: Use Nextcloud Files to give a project team a shared folder for design drafts, datasets and meeting notes.

guidance.bestFor: Keep the team's working documents together with access controlled by the organization running the service.
guidance.caveat: Students need access to a Nextcloud instance. If the team hosts its own, it also owns storage capacity, upgrades and backups.

community-dcb1fe42b9a89344.description: Install Sigma.js to draw an interactive network of people, documents or projects in a web page.

guidance.bestFor: Explore nodes and their connections, such as which projects depend on the same packages.
guidance.caveat: Supply the graph data and a layout for the nodes. The renderer cannot infer meaningful positions from a list of names.

community-df1010ff6cb936e1.description: Add clipboard.js to a browser page so a button copies a code snippet or a project brief.

guidance.bestFor: Let a student copy text from a specific element and see whether the copy succeeded.
guidance.caveat: If you mount and remove the button in a single-page app, destroy its clipboard instance on cleanup. Handle the error event too.

community-8e5c3476a9c655f9.description: Open the GDevelop game editor and connect conditions and actions to make a collectible disappear when a character touches it.

guidance.bestFor: Prototype a platform game's scoring rules in an event sheet and test them in the preview.
guidance.caveat: An event can run repeatedly while its condition remains true. Account for that when awarding points.

community-c985249d6a0e624c.description: Install Mastra to build a TypeScript agent that looks up information through a tool you define.

guidance.bestFor: Give a study assistant a narrow tool for retrieving assignment details and inspect when it calls that tool.
guidance.caveat: Choose and configure a compatible model separately, and validate the inputs accepted by each tool.

community-325aa537fe10517f.description: Run OctoPrint on a host connected to a 3D printer, then monitor jobs through its web interface.

guidance.bestFor: Watch the progress of a class prototype print from a browser on the printer's network.
guidance.caveat: You need a supported printer and a connected host. Verify the hardware and connection before designing around live print data.

community-2c78ac725bff409b.description: Install Hardhat to compile and test an Ethereum contract locally before deploying it.

guidance.bestFor: Write a test that checks which account may update a class voting contract and inspect a failed transaction.
guidance.caveat: Choose the network deliberately. Sending a transaction on a public chain has different consequences from a local simulation.

community-c91c30c354ab859e.description: Use the ColorZilla browser extension to sample a color from a page, or open its gradient editor to export CSS.

guidance.bestFor: Match a project's palette to an existing illustration without guessing the hex values.
guidance.caveat: A sampled pixel includes the effects of any overlay or gradient. Sample a flat region or inspect the original CSS for the intended token.

community-d509a8c0d98bfceb.description: Run Gemini CLI in a project directory to ask how a feature is implemented and review suggested edits.

guidance.bestFor: Trace an unfamiliar code path across files before changing the feature.
guidance.caveat: Configure a supported sign-in or API credential and check the proposed file changes and shell commands before accepting them.

community-e72ea032372579b3.description: Connect a database to Metabase and use its visual query builder to chart weekly survey responses.

guidance.bestFor: Turn a table of anonymous responses into a repeatable question and dashboard for the team.
guidance.caveat: The chart reflects the underlying rows. Check how duplicate responses are counted and who has permission to inspect them.

community-d9fa580077e68cf2.description: Install OpenCV and use its Canny tutorial to outline the edges of objects in a photo.

guidance.bestFor: Compare edge maps for the same object under different lighting before using them in a camera project.
guidance.caveat: The two thresholds affect which edges survive. Try them on representative images instead of tuning a single photograph.

community-bfd216e85c3ec1b2.description: Run Gotenberg in Docker and POST a web page or office document to get a PDF version.

guidance.bestFor: Give a report generator a repeatable server-side PDF export with browser rendering.
guidance.caveat: The conversion runs inside a container. Make sure stylesheets, fonts and images are reachable from there.

community-82b49b5fc70ca818.description: Open a CodyHouse component and adapt its markup and styles for a navigation menu or a new page section.

guidance.bestFor: Start from a working interface example and inspect its states before fitting it to your design.
guidance.caveat: Check the component's dependencies and license. Some examples use CodyHouse styles or paid assets.

community-27741b0025ef748d.description: Set up Gitea to host a team's repositories and use issues and pull requests to review changes.

guidance.bestFor: Practice a branch-and-review workflow on a Git service the school or team operates.
guidance.caveat: A self-hosted installation needs durable storage and someone responsible for upgrades and backups.

community-54b899b195996957.description: Add MLflow tracking calls to a training script to compare parameters and evaluation metrics across runs.

guidance.bestFor: Find which combination of features and model settings performed best on the same held-out dataset.
guidance.caveat: Metrics are only comparable when evaluation stays consistent. Record the dataset split along with the run's parameters.

community-617fe5fb70db9959.description: Run openHAB and create a rule that switches a light on when a sensor changes state.

guidance.bestFor: Combine events from connected devices in a classroom automation experiment.
guidance.caveat: Check for a binding for the actual device and protocol before planning an automation around it.

community-5e1a86347052daa5.description: Use the GrapesJS editor framework to let students assemble a club page from editable headings, images and layout blocks.

guidance.bestFor: Build a drag-and-drop page editor in which users can change the content and export their design.
guidance.caveat: The homepage features the Studio SDK. Use the core documentation if your project specifically needs the open-source framework.

community-969c8808eba4bd98.name: Mapbox documentation
community-969c8808eba4bd98.description: Follow Mapbox’s map guides to put campus locations on an interactive map; use the token guide when connecting the map to your site.

guidance.bestFor: Build a map that students can zoom and pan instead of displaying a static campus image.
guidance.caveat: Only expose a public token with appropriate scopes in the browser. Keep secret tokens on the server.

community-4c26c1eda3d9f901.description: Read Teleport’s setup and access guides to give teammates individual access to a shared development server.

guidance.bestFor: Replace a team’s shared SSH login with access tied to individual identities and roles.
guidance.caveat: You need authority to enroll the target machine and configure the team’s access policies before classmates can use it.

community-df2f568fba6a92c8.description: Open Mockoon, create a local API route and give it a sample JSON response so work on the frontend can start early.

guidance.bestFor: Test what a results page shows when an API returns records, an empty array or an error.
guidance.caveat: A passing test against a mock does not confirm that the real server returns the same status codes and fields.

community-3ce4f47b8c548942.description: Run Open WebUI and connect a model to give classmates a browser chat interface for comparing prompts.

guidance.bestFor: Give an existing model a usable local chat screen without building the conversation UI from scratch.
guidance.caveat: The interface still needs a model provider. A remote endpoint receives the prompts even if the interface runs on your computer.

community-dbd554708c38d775.description: Run ArchiveBox on a reading list to preserve copies of web pages in formats such as HTML, PDF and screenshots.

guidance.bestFor: Build a reference collection that preserves what a project source looked like when your team found it.
guidance.caveat: A screenshot can preserve the appearance of an interactive demo without preserving its behavior. Check the archived copy.

community-3e1fc8455f78f6ff.name: Databricks API reference
community-3e1fc8455f78f6ff.description: Look up a workspace endpoint in the Databricks API reference before writing code to trigger a data job or inspect its run.

guidance.bestFor: Automate a repetitive action in a Databricks workspace your class already uses.
guidance.caveat: API calls need workspace access and authorization; the reference itself does not supply a running workspace.

community-e30a300af7f0a596.description: Set up Home Assistant, connect a supported device and build an automation such as switching a light on when a sensor changes.

guidance.bestFor: Prototype a classroom installation that responds to a real sensor and exposes its state on a dashboard.
guidance.caveat: Check the integration for the particular device before buying hardware or designing a demo around it.

community-67e8513ec70150db.description: Run Navidrome against your own music files and browse the resulting collection through its web player or a compatible music client.

guidance.bestFor: Turn a collection of student-recorded tracks into a searchable listening library.
guidance.caveat: You supply the audio files. Accurate artist and album tags make the collection easier to browse.

community-3f828e58a73ebf93.description: Open an Overleaf project and collaborate on a LaTeX report with equations, citations and a compiled PDF preview.

guidance.bestFor: Write a team lab report where classmates can edit the same source and inspect the typeset result.
guidance.caveat: A typo in a LaTeX command can interrupt compilation. Check the build log when the PDF stops updating.

community-3fa62046261b458f.description: Watch Laracasts programming screencasts and follow a Laravel or PHP lesson in a small practice app.

guidance.bestFor: Learn one technique by watching it implemented, then reproduce it in a project your team controls.
guidance.caveat: Check the framework version used by the series before copying commands into a newer project.

community-dbbe5ae745ef7974.description: Read the Racket Guide’s examples of functions, lists and local bindings, then run small variations in a Racket environment.

guidance.bestFor: Translate familiar programming ideas into Racket and see how a list-processing function works.
guidance.caveat: The guide assumes some programming experience; beginners may need to learn basic programming concepts alongside it.

community-8f87a74e6edb72c2.description: Open Hoppscotch, send a request to a project endpoint and inspect its status, headers and response before wiring it into the UI.

guidance.bestFor: Determine whether a failing search screen is receiving bad data or failing to display a valid response.
guidance.caveat: The browser can block cross-origin requests. Pick one of the documented interceptors if the API does not permit the web client’s origin.

community-5a25ac7fd590f7b2.description: Install Apache NetBeans and open a Java project to edit, run and debug it in one desktop application.

guidance.bestFor: Set breakpoints and inspect values when a Java program produces the wrong result.
guidance.caveat: Check the JDK requirements for the NetBeans release and for the project you plan to open.

community-5681e98931e18a6c.description: Configure Panda CSS to turn styles and variants written in your app into generated CSS; try it on a button with several visual states.

guidance.bestFor: Share a set of style tokens and component variants without hand-maintaining a stylesheet for each combination.
guidance.caveat: The build needs to discover the styles in source. Use the documented CSS-variable approach for values known only at runtime.

community-6791f9ef32398f1b.description: Use StyleX to define reusable component styles in JavaScript and compile them into CSS; start with a shared button and its variants.

guidance.bestFor: Compose several styles while keeping their precedence predictable across components.
guidance.caveat: Set up the compiler for your build. Ordinary arbitrary JavaScript expressions are not interchangeable with styles the compiler can analyze.

community-263231022e5eba8f.name: Apache Druid
community-263231022e5eba8f.description: Follow the Apache Druid tutorials to ingest an event dataset and query counts grouped by time.

guidance.bestFor: Explore an analytics dashboard question such as which hour sees the most events across many records.
guidance.caveat: The quickstart runs a database with several services; for a small static chart you can work directly with a CSV instead.

community-ebb49573fa14f300.description: Open a Huly workspace to keep a student team’s issues, shared documents and project discussions together.

guidance.bestFor: Trace a bug from its initial report through the team’s discussion and assigned work.
guidance.caveat: Decide who needs workspace access before using it to collect feedback from people outside the team.

community-6b001533ac2e04ee.description: Experiment with nivo’s interactive bar chart, then use the React component to compare categories such as club attendance by month.

guidance.bestFor: Switch between stacked and grouped bars and see which one answers your audience’s question.
guidance.caveat: Match the chart’s keys and index field to your rows; changing the labels alone does not change which values are plotted.

community-f1403f358893ce86.description: Open Plane and put project issues into a board or development cycle so teammates can see what is ready, in progress and complete.

guidance.bestFor: Give a group project a shared backlog with assignees and a concrete next task for each person.
guidance.caveat: Agree on what each workflow state means; moving a task to Done will not run or verify its code.

community-cbb47273f53c79b9.description: Install Vue Final Modal and use it to build a dialog such as a confirmation screen that opens from a button.

guidance.bestFor: Reuse modal behavior across Vue screens while designing the dialog to fit the rest of the site.
guidance.caveat: Programmatic dialogs need the documented modal container mounted in your app; installing the package alone will not display them.

community-b00ca09b1ba3e06d.description: Browse F-Droid’s Android app catalog and open a project’s source link to investigate how it implements a feature.

guidance.bestFor: Find real open-source Android examples before designing an offline tool or mobile utility.
guidance.caveat: Check the individual project’s license before reusing code or artwork; appearance in the catalog does not erase its attribution terms.

community-ae2b30c1d47bbf46.description: Choose a project-based course on Hyperskill and work through its stages and exercises in a language you want to practice.

guidance.bestFor: Give a learner a sequence of small programming tasks that lead toward a finished project.
guidance.caveat: Check the language and prerequisites for the selected track before asking teammates to follow it.

community-dca1f40c815bc826.description: Set up NodeBB and organize a class help forum into topics and categories, then configure who can post and moderate.

guidance.bestFor: Keep recurring coding questions and answers searchable beyond a single chat conversation.
guidance.caveat: If you self-host, plan for the database, account permissions and moderation as well as the initial installation.

community-436501c01e8b3f18.description: Add Plausible’s tracking and a custom event to see how often visitors use a feature such as an export button.

guidance.bestFor: Measure whether people discover a new feature after a change to its placement or label.
guidance.caveat: Use the same event name in your tracking call and goal. A button click measures intent unless you fire the event after the export succeeds.

community-e6fadebd1b102e0e.description: Create a Linkwarden collection for research links, save pages and share the collection with your project team.

guidance.bestFor: Keep references with the team and retain archived versions when the original pages change.
guidance.caveat: Review collection visibility and sharing permissions before mixing private references with material classmates can open.

community-237cb89ffe666f21.description: Automate repeatable parts of a mobile release, such as capturing the same App Store screenshots across languages and devices.

guidance.bestFor: Regenerate screenshots from an iOS UI test after redesigning the onboarding flow.
guidance.caveat: For iOS screenshots, set up the test scheme and run snapshot from the command line. Running the test inside Xcode alone will not produce the finished files.

community-be5210116d9f02aa.description: Run a photo library and upload selected phone albums automatically to your own server.

guidance.bestFor: Collect a photography club's event pictures and browse them from a phone or web browser.
guidance.caveat: Back up both the database and media files. A copy of the database alone cannot restore missing photos.

community-021bc57bd1082f68.description: Open a folder of Markdown files as a vault and link project notes to design decisions, tests and meeting records.

guidance.bestFor: Keep a searchable engineering notebook beside a project and link each decision to the notes behind it.
guidance.caveat: Linking a note inside your vault does not share that file with your classmates. Choose how the team will exchange the vault or publish selected notes.

community-a6b5f6d91680cb08.description: Build a web application on the JVM with the Play framework, using Java or Scala for server routes.

guidance.bestFor: Add a server endpoint for a school events calendar when the team's backend already runs Java or Scala.
guidance.caveat: Match tutorials to the major version. Play 3 uses Pekko, while Play 2 uses Akka.

community-31696885b4e5f240.description: Install Blueprint to assemble dense React interfaces with tables, menus and other desktop-style controls.

guidance.bestFor: Create a desktop inventory screen where students browse many records and edit one in a panel.
guidance.caveat: Blueprint targets dense desktop interfaces. Try its controls at your smallest phone width before committing to it.

community-f117526bd42ed4e8.description: Open a generator to create a custom SVG texture, repeating pattern or gradient for a page background.
