guidance.bestFor: Make a subtle pattern behind a project header and change the palette without redrawing the shapes.
guidance.caveat: Check contrast with actual text on top of the exported background. The generator only shows the artwork.

community-1e68173e4cd26f4f.description: Pick an Ionicons outline, filled or sharp icon and import it into a navigation bar or toolbar.

guidance.bestFor: Give a saved item a filled bookmark and an unsaved item its outline counterpart.
guidance.caveat: Provide an accessible name on an icon-only button. The SVG artwork alone doesn't tell a screen reader what the button does.

community-6ed0fd3f24c91e68.description: Open an OpenProject board to organize a team's tasks into columns and assign work packages.

guidance.bestFor: Run a class project with a backlog and a board for work in progress and completed tasks.
guidance.caveat: Check the board type before promising automatic updates. A basic board and an action board handle card moves differently.

community-a19467d5ae999caf.description: Use a game server control panel to start a class server, inspect its console and manage its files.

guidance.bestFor: Host a multiplayer game for a student group with separate resource limits for each server.
guidance.caveat: Budget for an actual server. The panel manages it, and Wings runs the game instances on configured nodes.

community-977a08c9e792be4f.description: Follow the Svelte guide to package an existing web app for Android or iOS and call native device features.

guidance.bestFor: Turn a working Svelte camera project into a mobile build that can request device permissions.
guidance.caveat: Build the web assets before syncing them to a native project. Edits in the Svelte source do not automatically update the installed app.

community-977a08c9e792be4f.name: Capacitor for Svelte

community-8da5b343fdc01d23.description: Add Filestack's JavaScript file picker to let students choose attachments and return handles for the uploaded files.

guidance.bestFor: Let club members submit photos through a picker and display the uploaded image in a gallery.
guidance.caveat: The hosted picker requires a Filestack API key. Decide which file types and upload sources your form will accept.

community-096f42a09e6296a4.description: Send a public page URL to Jina Reader to extract text an agent can use as a research reference.

guidance.bestFor: Turn a long documentation page into text for a source-backed answer about your dependencies.
guidance.caveat: Check the extracted text against the original page, especially when the answer depends on a diagram or dynamic example.

community-e62a69cf528aa8e2.description: Run the PocketBase executable to get collections, sign-in, file uploads and live subscriptions for a small app.

guidance.bestFor: Prototype a shared classroom bulletin board where a new announcement appears without reloading.
guidance.caveat: Give the server persistent storage for its database and uploaded files. An ephemeral deployment can lose the project's data.

community-3d96d08f2c492c49.description: Write a slide deck in HTML and use reveal.js to navigate sections vertically and horizontally.

guidance.bestFor: Present an interactive coding demo with optional slides beneath a short main argument.
guidance.caveat: Check the PDF export separately. Incremental fragments can become separate pages when printed.

community-f213aa9d3b927b2c.description: Browse courses from universities and companies and use the syllabus to choose a topic for independent practice.

guidance.bestFor: Find a focused data-analysis lesson to help explain a chart your agent produced.
guidance.caveat: Check the particular course's prerequisites, projects and enrollment terms. Those vary across providers and programs.

community-95eac036c6560e57.description: Read the current-weather API documentation to look up temperature and conditions for a location.

guidance.bestFor: Add a weather panel to a club outings page using latitude and longitude.
guidance.caveat: Requests require an OpenWeather API key. Set the units explicitly so temperatures appear in the scale your interface promises.

community-c19f06586daba02b.description: Use the Kaboom.js examples to understand sprites, keyboard controls and collision areas in an existing browser game.

guidance.bestFor: Help an agent modify a small legacy platformer and trace which component gives the player a collider.
guidance.caveat: The maintainers have discontinued Kaboom.js. Choose it for an existing project with a known version, and weigh the maintenance cost before starting a new one.

community-659c57d0686bd6c7.description: Run a time-series database and use SQL to query sensor readings in timestamp order.

guidance.bestFor: Chart a greenhouse's temperature history and examine gaps in the measurements.
guidance.caveat: Choose the designated timestamp based on when the reading happened. It affects storage order and time-based queries.

community-6796d34f2a4e3c9e.description: Deploy Roundcube as a browser interface for reading and composing mail in an existing email account.

guidance.bestFor: Add webmail access to a lab mail-server experiment and inspect a message with an attachment.
guidance.caveat: Roundcube needs a working mail backend. Plan for IMAP access and outbound mail delivery separately from the web interface.

community-db5d5775c6829e67.description: Open the IT Tools collection to convert, encode or inspect a short value while debugging a web project.

guidance.bestFor: Decode a test Base64 value before comparing it with the text your application displays.
guidance.caveat: Pick the converter that matches the data format. A readable decoded value does not verify the origin or authenticity of its contents.

community-63f2a5253dd0487f.description: Run a DNS filter and inspect which domains a test device requests as it loads a page.

guidance.bestFor: Demonstrate DNS blocking by comparing the same browser request with a domain allowed and blocked.
guidance.caveat: Only devices using Pi-hole as their DNS resolver receive its filtering. Start by configuring a single test device.

community-f324d2e121295d75.description: Follow the LlamaIndex Python tutorial to load documents, index them and ask a question about their contents.

guidance.bestFor: Build a small Q&A demo over a collection of public course handouts and check the answer against the originals.
guidance.caveat: The linked starter uses OpenAI credentials. Choose an alternative model configuration if you need an entirely local demo.

community-3ac1f86baea65bbf.description: Paste a regular expression into a visual editor to inspect its groups, repetitions and alternatives.

guidance.bestFor: Explain why an identifier pattern accepts one sample student ID and rejects another.
guidance.caveat: Test the final expression in your app's own regex engine as well. Different languages can interpret the same pattern differently.

community-71ab5a8cfe8a2572.description: Read the migration guide to replace an existing webpack build with Rspack and measure the rebuild time.

guidance.bestFor: Speed up a large JavaScript project's development build while retaining compatible configuration.
guidance.caveat: Check loader, plugin and CLI flag compatibility. Some webpack flags cause Rspack to reject the command before loading the configuration.

community-42936db47b6a66a6.description: Browse font pairings and try a heading and body combination on a sample of your own writing.

guidance.bestFor: Choose a type pairing for a portfolio using both a large project title and a paragraph of notes.
guidance.caveat: Confirm the selected fonts' available weights and licenses with their publisher before bundling the font files.

community-6944a00d0f60fdff.description: Use ownCloud shared spaces to organize files for a team project and give members access to the right folders.

guidance.bestFor: Share an agreed set of media assets between the students editing a project.
guidance.caveat: Choose the deployment and sharing permissions before inviting the team. A member link and a public share grant different access.

community-68b60c069cdd77aa.description: Run a downloaded language model on your computer and send prompts to its local HTTP server from your app.

guidance.bestFor: Prototype a study assistant against a local model before connecting it to a hosted service.
guidance.caveat: Check that the model fits the host machine. A URL pointing to localhost will target each student's own computer when the app is shared.

community-382ade5d2b5ca59b.description: Use scipy.signal to filter, convolve or compare data sampled from a sensor or microphone.

guidance.bestFor: Smooth noisy measurements and plot the original and filtered traces together.
guidance.caveat: Set the sampling rate to match the measurement. Filter parameters interpreted at the wrong rate can erase the signal you want to keep.

community-b73747722cbf1e4b.description: Read Stitches' styling API to maintain variants and design tokens in an existing component library.

guidance.bestFor: Add a compact size variant to a button in a project that already styles components with Stitches.
guidance.caveat: The site states that Stitches is no longer maintained. Check compatibility with your project's current framework before expanding its use.

community-3e0d3bfa0ed5b618.description: Turn a document into a signing form, assign fields to its recipients and track completion in DocuSeal.

guidance.bestFor: Prototype a club equipment checkout with different fields for the requester and the person issuing the equipment.
guidance.caveat: Test with a sample document and each recipient role before sharing. A field assigned to the wrong role can block completion.

community-77d7496ad354c934.description: Connect Storyblok's visual editor to a frontend so an editor can preview changes to an article or landing page.

guidance.bestFor: Let club editors arrange reusable content blocks and see how a draft page will look.
guidance.caveat: Wire the frontend's preview route to the visual editor. Creating the content model alone does not make the rendered page editable.

community-3f06c538eac09bcf.description: Add Matomo tracking events to understand which features visitors actually use on a website.

guidance.bestFor: Measure how often users export a project brief compared with how often they open the results list.
guidance.caveat: Define and test distinct events for the two actions. A pageview counter cannot distinguish button presses within the same page.

community-86e99b69e060f870.description: Install Starship to show the current Git branch and other project context in your shell prompt.

guidance.bestFor: Help teammates notice which repository and branch they are using before running a command.
guidance.caveat: Add the initialization command for each shell in use. Some prompt symbols also need a compatible font.

community-86e99b69e060f870.name: Starship

community-b61675685c0bd162.description: Use Temporal workflows and activities to coordinate long-running jobs that can resume after an interruption.

guidance.bestFor: Process a set of uploaded videos through separate encoding and notification steps.
guidance.caveat: Keep workflow logic deterministic for replay. Put external calls and operations with side effects in activities.

community-e88a4e7129dfe79b.description: Call a hosted media model through fal and track an image-generation job from a prompt to its result.

guidance.bestFor: Build a storyboard page that can queue a generation and show its status while a student continues editing.
guidance.caveat: Keep the API key on your server. A key shipped in frontend code can be reused by anyone who receives the page.

community-fcac8d62df5f65a3.description: Store data on the client with RxDB and replicate changes when the app regains a connection.

guidance.bestFor: Build a field notebook that still accepts observations while the student is offline.
guidance.caveat: Choose a conflict rule for simultaneous edits. Replication moves writes between devices, but the application must decide which version to keep.

community-cde30850ac43b4c1.description: Create a Micronaut backend with HTTP controllers and compile-time dependency injection.

guidance.bestFor: Expose a JVM-based timetable service to a school website through a JSON endpoint.
guidance.caveat: Configure annotation processing for your language and build tool. Micronaut generates wiring during compilation.

community-164811526484ff1f.description: Model content in Strapi and fetch it from automatically generated REST endpoints in a separate frontend.

guidance.bestFor: Let an editor publish club announcements and have a public website request them by date.
guidance.caveat: Configure content permissions and request related fields explicitly when needed. A created content type alone does not make every record and relation available.

community-24ec07b23f1ddd7a.description: Create a Chroma collection, add text and query it by similarity to a new question.

guidance.bestFor: Find related passages in a set of project notes even when students phrase their questions differently.
guidance.caveat: Keep document identifiers alongside the matches and show the original passage. A close embedding match does not establish that a claim is correct.

community-6c5a5ce056ffba0b.description: Search the Open VSX extension registry for add-ons that work in compatible code editors.

guidance.bestFor: Find a language extension for a classroom editor and share its exact publisher and extension name.
guidance.caveat: Check the extension's required editor version and whether your editor uses Open VSX. A listing alone does not guarantee compatibility with every VS Code-based editor.

community-508b9151abe19ae4.description: Send HTTP requests from your editor, inspect the responses and organize related requests into a collection.

guidance.bestFor: Reproduce the difference between submitting a valid form and submitting one with a missing field to a test API.
guidance.caveat: Check that the request's active environment points to the intended server before replaying a saved collection.

community-948c1b3e35d44259.description: Use the Mintlify starter to build a documentation site from pages kept alongside code in a repository.

guidance.bestFor: Publish a getting-started guide with a working request example for a student-built API.
guidance.caveat: Choose how deployments are connected to the repository. Editing a local page only updates the public site after the publishing workflow runs.

community-410461011d06a77d.description: Open a source file in Sublime Text and use column selection to edit aligned values across many lines at once.

guidance.bestFor: Clean up repeated sample data or add the same prefix to a block of identifiers.
guidance.caveat: Column selection follows the visible rectangle. Check for lines of unequal length before applying a multi-line edit.

community-3ecd0dabd1c3bbd5.description: Connect translation files in a repository to Weblate so translators can review interface strings in a browser.

guidance.bestFor: Translate the navigation and error messages of a student-built app while keeping changes in version control.
guidance.caveat: Set up the source strings and repository integration before inviting translators. Updates must still reach the version your app builds from.

community-dc2079ec4672e491.description: Open a Livebook notebook to combine written explanations with runnable Elixir code cells.

guidance.bestFor: Share a small data-cleaning experiment with a classmate who can change the inputs and reevaluate each step.
guidance.caveat: A notebook's saved text does not preserve a running runtime. Include setup cells and rerun dependencies when reopening it.

community-39f02042ee4094e6.description: Use Taiga's Kanban board, backlog and issue tracking to organize work for a team project.

guidance.bestFor: Move tasks across columns as a group implements and tests a feature.
guidance.caveat: Taiga's board manages the team's work. If you want draggable columns inside your own product, choose an embeddable board component separately.

community-95600659c05fc4d5.description: Declare the tools a project uses with Nix so teammates can enter the same development environment.

guidance.bestFor: Share a reproducible compiler and command-line tool setup across a team.
guidance.caveat: Pin the package inputs and check the target platforms. A shared list of package names alone does not fix their versions.

community-be4d333f6dd68eb2.description: Use SurrealDB graph relations to store records and query connections between them.

guidance.bestFor: Model club members, events and attendance so you can follow links in either direction.
guidance.caveat: Choose a graph relation when the connection needs its own meaning or fields. A simple record link can be sufficient for an ordinary reference.

community-d8fdb6a7dcf7807c.description: Use Zulip topics to keep separate project discussions in one channel easy to find and follow.

guidance.bestFor: Give a coding team a place for bug reports, deployment questions and design decisions without interleaving all the replies.
guidance.caveat: Choose a specific topic when starting a conversation. Replies sent to a broad catch-all topic are harder for teammates to find later.

community-a52e32fc9cb08d05.description: Send an HTTP POST to an ntfy topic to deliver a notification to a subscribed phone or desktop.

guidance.bestFor: Have a build script alert a student when a long-running export finishes.
guidance.caveat: For a shared project, configure access control before publishing private information. A topic name alone is not an authorization rule.

community-ce0d61199427e31e.name: Open-Meteo
community-ce0d61199427e31e.description: Plot hourly temperatures for your town by sending latitude and longitude to the forecast API.

guidance.bestFor: Build a weather widget and let students compare the forecast at two locations.
guidance.caveat: Request units and a time zone explicitly so local chart labels match the forecast. The free hosted endpoint has noncommercial usage limits.

community-003792addce58608.name: Open-Meteo Ensemble
community-003792addce58608.description: Draw a range of possible temperatures from multiple members of a weather forecast model.

guidance.bestFor: Show forecast uncertainty by plotting the spread of model runs for the same location and hour.
guidance.caveat: Lead times and ensemble size vary by model. Select variables the model supports and label the model on the chart.

community-e38846b4eca76a34.name: Pirate Weather
community-e38846b4eca76a34.description: Fetch a local forecast by coordinates using the Pirate Weather API.

guidance.bestFor: Build a forecast card or adapt a project that uses Dark Sky style weather fields.
guidance.caveat: Subscribe and obtain an API key before making requests. Route requests through your server so the key stays private.

community-61eca8c1b4525101.name: National Weather Service API
community-61eca8c1b4525101.description: Look up a US location and follow its forecast URL to build a local weather page.

guidance.bestFor: Make a school dashboard that shows the next forecast period for a nearby US town.
guidance.caveat: Coverage is regional. Identify your application in requests and use the forecast URLs the points endpoint returns.

community-5ec37b639825806a.description: Send a project update to an in-app inbox, then add an email step to the same notification workflow.

guidance.bestFor: An app that needs to notify the same person on different channels.
guidance.caveat: Decide which channel you can deliver through before building the workflow. Test with a single subscriber first.

community-c32f8a9c0d28158f.description: Share a set of button styles and form controls between a React website and a React Native app.

guidance.bestFor: A team maintaining the same sign-up flow on phones and the web.
guidance.caveat: Try one shared screen on each target. Web-only elements in a component still need a native counterpart.

community-7c78f47a8a7f0809.name: ApostropheCMS
community-7c78f47a8a7f0809.description: Build a club site whose editors can update text and images on the page through a visual CMS.

guidance.bestFor: A site where contributors need to publish updates without editing the project source.
guidance.caveat: The CMS runs as a Node.js application. Plan where it will run when the site is published.

community-877dd36ca5ab7c80.description: Start an attendance dashboard from an admin template and add interface components for the framework your class already uses.

guidance.bestFor: An internal tool with a navigation sidebar, forms and tables.
guidance.caveat: The catalog mixes free templates with paid PRO components. Check the edition of any component you pick.

community-baa1070f64bd666a.description: Follow Khronos tutorials and samples to draw a scene with a low-level graphics API.

guidance.bestFor: An advanced native graphics project where you want control over how the GPU renders a frame.
guidance.caveat: Check the graphics driver and SDK for your target machine before adapting a sample.

community-41115ead3cd415e3.name: Exercism Rust Track
community-41115ead3cd415e3.description: Work through a short Rust exercise such as translating RNA into proteins, then use the feedback to improve your solution.

guidance.bestFor: Practicing one Rust problem at a time or comparing your code with a mentor’s feedback.
guidance.caveat: Joining the track requires signing in. Volunteer mentoring is a separate step after you solve an exercise.

community-516ae926b897b3cb.description: Edit translated labels in the running interface so a classmate can see which button or menu a phrase belongs to.

guidance.bestFor: A bilingual app whose translators need to see the surrounding screen.
guidance.caveat: Decide how the app loads its translation strings before inviting teammates to edit them.

community-8fb6203b01f4ccf4.description: Give a frontend a mock HTTP endpoint and return delayed responses or errors to test its loading and retry states.

guidance.bestFor: Developing a client while the team is still building the real API.
guidance.caveat: Use sample payloads when testing. The request inspector displays headers and bodies sent to the endpoint.

community-26cfd16cd1882d42.description: Publish a project walkthrough in Markdown and give classmates one link to your code examples and build notes.

guidance.bestFor: Keeping a public development journal or sharing a tutorial with other developers.
guidance.caveat: You need to sign in to publish. Use a private draft while editing material that is not ready to share.

community-f6c5bbf87955e312.description: Host a club wiki or blog from the YunoHost app catalog and manage it through the server’s admin interface.

guidance.bestFor: A team that wants to learn how to operate a server for its own apps.
guidance.caveat: Plan who will maintain the server, install updates and restore backups after the project launches.

community-9156bfb54aacb5b2.description: Build a small iOS activity picker and see how changing state updates the text and image on screen.

guidance.bestFor: A first native iPhone app that responds to a button tap.
guidance.caveat: The walkthrough uses Xcode on a Mac. Allow time to install it before starting the exercise.

community-c887f2babf622c0a.description: Write one SQL query that joins an event log in object storage to records in a relational database.

guidance.bestFor: Analyzing data split across systems without copying it into one database first.
guidance.caveat: Trino runs queries against connected sources. Set up the relevant connectors and access to each source first.

community-6a091669bf9d3c23.description: Connect an API or database to a live chart and embed it in a team report.

guidance.bestFor: An analytics page where several charts need to stay in sync with the source data.
guidance.caveat: The hosted product offers a trial. For a longer-running class dashboard, compare the hosted plan with the self-hosted project.

community-45f6307e502ba42b.description: Try a regular expression or a JavaScript function in a desktop scratchpad and watch the result change as you type.

guidance.bestFor: Checking one small piece of an agent’s code before putting it into an app.
guidance.caveat: The scratchpad includes Node.js and browser APIs together. Check the snippet again in the environment where you will ship it.

community-84470f355df5222f.name: Actual Budget
community-84470f355df5222f.description: Try the budgeting demo with sample expenses, or use the local API to build a custom transaction importer.

guidance.bestFor: A personal finance project exploring envelope budgets or transaction imports.
guidance.caveat: The demo is enough for exploring a budget. Syncing your own data across devices requires a server.

community-199f54a303c3a414.name: React Image Crop
community-199f54a303c3a414.description: Let a user crop a profile picture with a resizable selection, fixed aspect ratio, and keyboard controls in React.

guidance.bestFor: Adding an accessible avatar crop step before saving a profile picture.
guidance.caveat: The crop editor needs an export and storage step in your app; check phone photo orientation before cropping.

community-64420effefa6ff04.name: React Easy Crop
community-64420effefa6ff04.description: Add a draggable, zoomable profile picture cropper with rotation and a round avatar preview in React.

guidance.bestFor: Letting someone position their face inside a circular profile image before upload.
guidance.caveat: Crop callbacks return coordinates; use the export example to produce an image. Give the cropper a positioned parent and avoid scale animations on its dialog.

community-aa2d56a8a61a7278.name: React Dropzone
community-aa2d56a8a61a7278.description: Build a drag-and-drop image picker for a profile photo or attachment form, with file acceptance and size checks.

guidance.bestFor: Selecting a local image before passing it to a cropper and upload handler.
guidance.caveat: This handles file selection, not HTTP upload or image cropping. Connect the accepted files to your own editor and upload request.

community-b79e689c2e7c2468.name: FilePond
community-b79e689c2e7c2468.description: Add a file upload interface with image previews, progress, and optional validation, resize, and crop plugins.

guidance.bestFor: Uploading profile pictures or project attachments with visible progress and a preview.
guidance.caveat: Asynchronous uploads need configured server endpoints. Image preview, validation, and transformation features require their corresponding plugins.

community-5f777abb63ec3a7a.name: Vue Picture Cropper
community-5f777abb63ec3a7a.description: Add a Vue 3 image cropping panel for profile pictures using a wrapper around Cropper.js.

guidance.bestFor: Cropping an avatar in an existing Vue 3 project.
guidance.caveat: Follow the documented Cropper.js major version when installing the peer dependency; the current installation example uses cropperjs@^1.

community-ca8a8cfa32ad9678.name: React Native Image Crop Picker
community-ca8a8cfa32ad9678.description: Choose a photo from the camera or gallery, crop it, and compress it in a React Native iOS or Android app.

guidance.bestFor: Adding a profile photo picker to a native mobile app.
guidance.caveat: This is a native mobile dependency, not a browser cropper. Configure platform permissions and match the package version to your React Native architecture.

community-98c6de16bf137f88.name: Dropzone
community-98c6de16bf137f88.description: Add drag-and-drop file uploads with image thumbnails and progress bars to a JavaScript website.

guidance.bestFor: A plain JavaScript attachment form that uploads files to an existing endpoint.
guidance.caveat: The upload UI still needs a server endpoint that accepts the files; use React Dropzone instead if you only need React file selection hooks.

community-f40273321ce20f7a.name: Lighthouse (Chrome)
community-f40273321ce20f7a.description: Audit a slow website for performance, accessibility, and loading issues, then follow the report to investigate specific fixes.

guidance.bestFor: Finding why a website loads slowly before asking an agent to change images, scripts, or styles.
guidance.caveat: The catalog link is the Chrome extension. Chrome recommends its built-in DevTools Lighthouse panel for local or signed-in pages; use the official guide below.

community-f72e37d8046bb30e.name: DebugBear Speed Test
community-f72e37d8046bb30e.description: Investigate a slow website with a page speed report, loading filmstrip, and network request waterfall.

guidance.bestFor: Seeing which images, scripts, or server requests delay a website loading.
guidance.caveat: A synthetic speed test describes its test conditions, not every visitor. Compare equivalent runs and distinguish load measurements from real-user data.

community-4b6ef69bbb91a22f.name: Addy Osmani / Performance
community-4b6ef69bbb91a22f.description: Give an agent a measurement-first workflow to investigate why a website is slow and verify improvements to loading and responsiveness.

guidance.bestFor: Turning a slow website complaint into a measured bottleneck and a before-and-after check.
guidance.caveat: The skill is a workflow, not a profiler. Supply a runnable page and browser measurements; code-only observations remain hypotheses.

community-80d9da837dafae68.name: Addy Osmani / Core Web Vitals
community-80d9da837dafae68.description: Guide an agent through slow content loading, delayed clicks, and jumping layouts using LCP, INP, and CLS evidence.

guidance.bestFor: Diagnosing a hero image that appears late, an unresponsive button, or a page that shifts while loading.
guidance.caveat: Keep lab traces separate from real-user metrics. A local improvement does not establish an immediate improvement for production visitors.

community-3aeac145af671259.name: Anthropic / Webapp Testing
community-3aeac145af671259.description: Help an agent test a local website with Python Playwright scripts, browser screenshots, and console logs.

guidance.bestFor: Checking that a sign-up form, search, or navigation works in a running browser after an agent changes the app.
guidance.caveat: The workflow needs a running app plus Python Playwright and a browser. Its helper can manage servers, but you must define the interactions and expected results.

community-58a00da73924083d.name: Anthropic / Frontend Design
community-58a00da73924083d.description: Give an agent a visual design process for choosing typography, color, layout, and motion that fit your website and audience.

guidance.bestFor: Replacing a generic landing page with a deliberate design based on the product, content, and users.
guidance.caveat: This supplies design guidance rather than ready-made components. Give the agent a concrete brief and inspect the rendered result.

community-f3f381153e968b47.name: Vercel / Web Design Guidelines
community-f3f381153e968b47.description: Review UI code for accessibility, forms, focus states, motion, and other web interface details with file-and-line findings.

guidance.bestFor: Having an agent audit a page before sharing it, especially keyboard use, form labels, and motion preferences.
guidance.caveat: The skill fetches the current guidelines and needs the files to review. A code review should be followed by keyboard and browser checks.

community-5bea86da45f8d2b2.name: Google PageSpeed Insights API
community-5bea86da45f8d2b2.description: Learn to request Lighthouse performance reports for a website from JavaScript or the command line, including diagnostics for slow page loads.

guidance.bestFor: Building a website speed checker or asking an agent to collect repeatable page performance reports.
guidance.caveat: This entry opens API documentation. For a one-off report use the PageSpeed Insights website; use the separate CrUX APIs for real-user data as Google plans to remove that data from this API.
